XRXRlabs · Engineering Closed

XRlabs Real-Time Vision Challenge

Train and deploy a model that distinguishes surgical instruments in live video; the top five models are tested on real surgical footage.

FIRST PRIZE
£1,000
Reward details
GBP 1,000 / 600 / 400, a hardware prize and US$100 NVIDIA Brev credits per participant.
Application deadline (time and timezone unstated)
22 Oct 2026 (exact cutoff time not announced)
Format & location
In person · London, UK
Who can apply
Individual entry; 20 places, approval-based. Vision-model skills required, no medical background needed. Age, international admission and fees unstated. NDA and data licence required.
Team size
1 participant

Entry notes

  • Event 24 October, 10:00–19:00 at the London Institute for Healthcare Engineering.
  • Models trained on XRlabs data cannot be published or commercialised and must be deleted after the event.
  • Computer vision
  • Healthcare
  • Physical AI
